purpose.zh: 不加重量，练脚踝把脚底往里翻的控制
purpose.en: Train control of turning the sole of your foot inward, with no added weight.

text.zh: 小腿不动，脚底慢慢向里翻
text.en: Keep your shin still and slowly turn your sole inward

text.zh: 一只手轻扶椅子，这只脚悬空。
text.en: Rest one hand lightly on a chair and lift this foot off the floor.

text.zh: 小幅度翻到位，再慢慢回正。
text.en: Turn through a small range, then come back slowly.

commonErrors.zh: 转小腿或转髋来代替脚踝
commonErrors.en: Turning the shin or hip instead of the ankle.

cautions.zh: 扶稳没有轮子的椅子，疼或站不稳时就停
cautions.en: Use a stable chair without wheels, and stop if it hurts or you feel unsteady.

changes: 改名「扶椅悬空足内翻控制」→「扶椅脚底向内翻」，EN 去 Inversion
节奏按 spec 时间轴手算（派生值把 90% 以上都算停顿，和 spec 不符）：翻 1.5/停 2.0/回 2.0/歇 2.5 s
caution 改「X 时 Y」短句
